notes: New Omen experience Circuit, parity theme 1 (neon glass column, taken further). Cards hang off a glowing circuit trace by lit nodes, with cut corners. Inside each: Kore-style split arcs with a glowing value end, slanted hatch meters, wide…

Two light sources, one per hue, throw 3D light on the cards: the faces toward them brighten, the edges facing them catch a rim, and the cards cast soft shadows away. In a column or strip the lights sit at the ends of the trace.

Circuit comes in four palettes (Toxin, Solar, Plasma, Neon) and lays out for every shape: a column for tower and ultra-tall, a row for strips, and a grid with the time across the top for landscape, square and portrait. Frames replace…
